dataformat.name: zipFile
dataformat.title: Zip File
dataformat.description: Compression and decompress streams using java.util.zip.Zip*Stream
dataformat.label: dataformat,transformation,file

marshalIn.description: The content of the one entry: text in the charset of the exchange, bytes, a stream or a file. The entry name is the file name of the CamelFileName header (its whole path with preservePathElements), or the message id

marshalOut.description: The zip file in the stream cache, or a byte array when stream caching is off. The CamelFileName header is the entry name with .zip

unmarshalIn.description: A zip file with one entry, or with several when usingIterator

unmarshalOut.description: The content of the one file in the stream cache, or a byte array when stream caching is off; folder entries are skipped, and a zip with more files fails. With usingIterator, an Iterator for the split EIP: of messages with the content of one file each, in a stream cache

usingIterator.description: If the zip file has more than one entry, the setting this option to true, allows working with the splitter EIP, to split the data using an iterator in a streaming mode.

allowEmptyDirectory.description: If the zip file has more than one entry, setting this option to true, allows to get the iterator even if the directory is empty.

preservePathElements.description: If the file name contains path elements, setting this option to true, allows the path to be maintained in the zip file.

maxDecompressedSize.label: advanced
maxDecompressedSize.description: Set the maximum decompressed size of a zip file (in bytes). The default value if not specified corresponds to 1 gigabyte. Set to -1 to disable setting a maximum decompressed size.
